caseSensitive.description: Whether Foo and foo are different symbols. They are unless the assembler was given -nocase (or the source says `opt c-`), so leave this on unless the project is assembled with case folded.

escapeSequences.description: Whether the assembler reads backslash escapes in strings (vasm -esc), so "a\n" holds a newline. Off unless vasm was given -esc. Without it, suspicious/string-escape-sequence flags escapes that would not mean what they say.

inlineConfig.description: Honor m68k-lint directives embedded in assembly comments.

projectSymbols.description: Resolve constants and macros a file does not define by indexing the rest of the project. A name is used only where every file that defines it agrees on one definition. Set false to analyse each file strictly alone.

presets.description: Optional rule presets. recommended is the normal baseline; style enables subjective convention rules.

ignores.description: Globs of files not to lint. They are still read for the constants and macros they define, so findings are not reported in a system include but its symbols still resolve.

includePaths.description: Directories the assembler is given to find includes in (vasm -I). Absolute, or relative to this file. Includes found through them are read for the constants and macros they define, so files shared between projects can live outside the project, but they are never linted.

sourceRoot.description: The directory relative paths in the source, such as an include, resolve from: where the assembler is run. Absolute, or relative to this file. Looked in for includes before includePaths. Overrides sourceRoot in .m68krc.json.

fixAnnotate.description: Keep original source as comments for intent-obscuring rules, all fixes, or none.
